aliases: Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's Savage Wilderness Great World

summary.text: Savage Wilderness Great World is Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's red great world among the three great worlds of Crazed Demon Cave's eighth layer.

claims.text: Cloud people in the eighth-layer void tell Fang Yuan of a ferocious, tall, and burly sage whose every action brings countless beast roars, and who created Savage Wilderness Great World, naming it beside Green Lotus Dao field and Yellow Earth Great World.

Lu Wei Yin explains that Reckless Savage Demon Venerable created Savage Wilderness Great World in the eighth layer of Crazed Demon Cave, just as Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable created Green Lotus Dao field and Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable made Yellow Earth Great World.

When Fang Yuan and Lu Wei Yin reach the eighth-layer void, three great-world bubbles sit joint at the center, green, yellow, and red, with smaller worlds linked around them. Narration treats the red world as the one Reckless Savage left behind, seen together with Genesis Lotus’s world when Yellow Earth comes into view. Qin Ding Ling in Green Lotus Great World orders Demon Judgment Board to suppress and resist Savage Wilderness Great World as well as restrain Longevity Heaven.

Longevity Heaven occupies Savage Wilderness Great World. Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace floats there as a grand and ancient dark gold palace. Bing Sai Chuan weighs whether Longevity Heaven should keep pressing Yellow Earth Great World or change plan after Fang Yuan and Lu Wei Yin arrive. The three great worlds were made one after another: Savage Wilderness Great World has the longest history, Green Lotus Great World is second, and Yellow Earth Great World is the most recent. Savage Wilderness forces fight Yellow Earth inhabitants on a separate front, including experts such as the six legged black tiger Hei Liu Biao and the snow wing eagle Xue Li Du.

Bing Sai Chuan states that Savage Wilderness Great World has the most Gu Immortals among the three, yet most have their own intentions and do not obey orders, so Longevity Heaven cannot simply unify them into the strongest world.

Limitless’s will recounts that Reckless Savage Demon Venerable left behind Savage Wilderness Great World after small worlds first appeared in the eighth-layer void, and that Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable’s Green Lotus Dao field later promoted the crazed demon ninth void formation further. When the world boundary breaks, Reckless Savage’s will flies out of Savage Wilderness Great World with countless fierce beasts.

Immortal Zombie Giant Sun remembers that after the four venerable wills paid a huge price repairing the world, Reckless Savage’s will fell into deep slumber, and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable used the chance to get rid of that will and take over control of Savage Wilderness Great World.

When Star Constellation Immortal Venerable drives Heavenly Court sub-formations across the fusing worlds, narration calls Savage Wilderness Great World vast and desolate as green light spreads over it from Green Lotus Great World.

Narration of the Crazed Demon Cave contest names Savage Wilderness Great World’s Longevity Heaven as one of the three parties, alongside Green Lotus Great World’s Heavenly Court and Yellow Earth Great World’s Paradise Earth.
